page: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-44-lssd is an x86_64 server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The machine provides 44 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped across 22 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, accompanied by 105 MB of L3 cache. It incorporates 176 GB of system memory, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per virtual core. Attached to the system are 3216 GB of local NVMe solid-state storage distributed across eight drives. Hardware acceleration includes Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 vector sets, while dedicated graphical processing units are absent.

Benchmark measurements position this instance in the middle tier for general computation, recording a Geekbench multi-core score of 15429.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 47611.69. Hardware-assisted cryptography demonstrates superior capability, reaching 38720.91 on the PassMark encryption evaluation to place in the top quartile. In memory testing, uncached large-block reads attain 111.44 GB/sec, while static web serving throughput measures 40.85 GB/sec. Specialized matrix instructions enable strong text generation speeds for small language models at 265.38 tokens per second, though execution rates decline to 2.37 tokens per second on large 70-billion parameter models due to the absence of dedicated accelerators.

This instance balances substantial host compute density with integrated low-latency NVMe drives, providing efficient local resource consolidation without requiring supplementary storage attachments. Workload profiles that align directly with this hardware include medium-to-large relational databases, distributed datastores, real-time caching layers such as Redis clusters, intensive software compilation jobs, and general enterprise application hosting.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-44-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine equipped with 44 vCPUs and 22 physical cores derived from an Intel Xeon 8481C processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. The configuration pairs 176 GB of system memory with 3216 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage across eight drives. Compute performance is reinforced by hardware support for AVX-512 and Intel AMX matrix extensions, contributing to strong cryptographic throughput and solid image processing metrics. While large-scale language model inference is constrained by the lack of dedicated GPU hardware, the server maintains stable average performance across multi-core arithmetic, decompression, and in-memory key-value operations. The direct coupling of substantial core density, balanced RAM, and bundled high-throughput local storage makes this server well configured for transactional database hosting, containerized enterprise services, intermediate continuous integration builds, and search indexing pipelines.
